//: Typechecks the TEST tree, which `tsconfig.json` deliberately excludes.
The build config excludes `test/` because a test file must not be emitted into
`dist/`. The effect was that no test file was typechecked by anything: `npm test`
runs through `tsx`, which strips types without checking them. A test could therefore
assert against a field that no longer exists, or pass a literal outside a union, and
only fail at runtime — or worse, pass while testing something else. Six classes of
drift were found the first time this ran.
`npm run typecheck:tests` runs this. `scripts/release/verify-release.mjs` includes it.
`rootDir` is widened to the repository root: the build config pins it to `src`, which
is right for emit and wrong here, because the test tree imports the MCP package. It
has no effect on output because `noEmit` is set.
`allowJs` is on because some release guards live in `scripts/release/*.mjs` and are
tested from this tree — a guard is only a guard if its refusals are asserted, and
`private-packages.mjs` exports its rule so a fixture tree can be driven through it.
Without `allowJs` the import is a compile error and the guard's refusals go untested.
`checkJs` stays off, so the JavaScript itself is inferred rather than type-checked.
